description:
It’s no secret that Jeff is heavily into vintage mountain bike collecting and riding. It was only a matter of time until he channeled that passion into a contemporary design.

The Dog Star is a fillet brazed, bi-laminate construction, all-terrain bicycle. A mix of classic styling with some modern features thrown in. Great for daily use, bikepacking, touring, exploring, etc.

26” wheels, extra top tube for extra style, bi-laminate construction because it’s the best of both worlds, lugs and fillets. A 1” threaded headset, a mid-blade fork mount and three pack mounts under the down tube for cargo carrying and rack options. Standard fender and rear rack mounts.

*If you want one, no two will be exactly alike, we will tailor your Dog Star to your hopes, dreams, aspirations, and physical dimensions. A frame and fork shall be $3900 with a custom paint job included.*

Standard Features

Pacenti fork crown

Mid Blade fork mounts

1" Threaded steerer tube

26 x 2.4" tire clearance

135mm rear spacing

Two bottles in main triangle (size permitting)

Three Pack mount under downtube

Rear rack mount

Fender mounts

Add Ons

Bull Moose Bar ($450)

Dynamo routing on fork ($50)

Three Pack mounts on fork ($70)

Internal rear brake cable routing ($100)

TUBING

Reynolds 853 comprises the majority of the frame, but we may elect to make substitutions based on size, design, etc.

FRAME SPEC

135mm rear spacing

68mm English BB Shell

1" threaded headset

27.2 Seatpost

COMPLETE BIKE BUILD SPEC

We're happy to sell you a frameset or a complete bike. Let's build you the Dog Star of your dreams. Contact us to get started.

FINISH

Painted with Imron paint by Rick at D & D Cycles. Rick is a freaking legend and a really kind person. We consider ourselves lucky to be his client.

DELIVERY

Expect it to take 4-5 months for us to build you one and get it back from paint.

SAFETY

Please read the bicycle owners manual before riding. This is important for safe operation of your new bike. Bicycle Owners Manual
